items.title: Memphis to Host Army in Homecoming Matchup on Halloween Night
items.summary: MEMPHIS, Tenn. – The University of Memphis (6-2, 3-1 American) football team looks to stay on track in a key conference matchup, hosting Army (5-2, 4-1 American) on Halloween Night inside Simmons Bank Liberty Stadium, also taking place during Memphis' Homecoming Weekend.

items.title: Davis Named to Earl Campbell Tyler Rose Award Honorable Mention List
items.summary: TYLER, Texas – University of Memphis wide receiver Jemyri Davis was listed as an honorable mention for the Earl Campbell Tyler Rose Award Player of the Week, the organization announced Tuesday.

items.title: Memphis-South Florida to Air on ESPN
items.summary: IRVING, Texas – The University of Memphis football program's road matchup at South Florida will air on ESPN at 7 p.m. CT. on Thursday, Nov. 12 in Raymond James Stadium.

items.title: Stokes Picks Up Manning Award Stars of the Week Recognition
items.summary: NEW ORLEANS – University of Memphis quarterback Marcus Stokes was named to the Manning Award Stars of the Week list for a second time this season, the award committee announced Monday.

items.title: Stokes Named to Davey O’Brien Great 8 for Second Time in 2026
items.summary: FORT WORTH, Texas – For the second time this season, University of Memphis quarterback Marcus Stokes was named to the Davey O'Brien Award Great 8, the Davey O'Brien Foundation announced on Monday.

items.title: Stokes Tabbed American Weekly Honorable Mention
items.summary: IRVING, Texas – University of Memphis quarterback Marcus Stokes was named one of the American Conference's weekly honorable mentions, the conference announced Monday morning.

items.title: Stokes Added to Manning Award Watch List
items.summary: NEW ORLEANS – University of Memphis quarterback Marcus Stokes was one of 15 signal callers added to the Manning Award Watch List, the Allstate Sugar Bowl announced Friday.

items.title: Tigers Take Down East Carolina 41-34 in Overtime, Become Bowl Eligible for 13th Straight Season
items.summary: MEMPHIS, Tenn. – The University of Memphis (6-2, 3-1 American) football team overcame a two-score deficit in the second half, eventually defeating East Carolina (3-4, 1-2 American) 41-34 in overtime Thursday night in Simmons Bank Liberty Stadium.

items.title: Memphis to Host East Carolina Thursday Night
items.summary: MEMPHIS, Tenn. – The University of Memphis (5-2, 2-1 American) football team hosts East Carolina (3-3, 1-1 American) Thursday night inside Simmons Bank Liberty Stadium for the DeAngelo Williams Foundation Breast Cancer Awareness game.

items.title: Huff Named to Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year Award Watch List
items.summary: HOUSTON – University of Memphis head football coach Charles Huff was one of 28 head coaches to be named to the Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year Award watch list, the organization announced Wednesday.
